subject: pathology
title: Liver Function Tests, Viral and Autoimmune Hepatitis, Interface Hepatitis, and Cirrhosis

steps.tx: Liver function tests misnamed still orient injury: transaminases mark hepatocyte damage, alkaline phosphatase and GGT mark cholestasis, while bilirubin, albumin, and prothrombin time judge true function. Pattern before panic is **liver enzyme pattern interpretation**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: Hepatocellular, cholestatic, or failing: classify the liver pattern before chasing its cause.

steps.tx: Acute viral hepatitis inflames lobules with hepatocyte ballooning, apoptosis Councilman bodies, and spotty necrosis, ALT often exceeding a thousand, usually resolving except hepatitis B and C chronicity paths. That lobular storm is **acute viral hepatitis histology and course**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: ALT in thousands with spotty necrosis is acute viral hepatitis until drugs and ischaemia are excluded.

steps.tx: Ground glass hepatocytes pack cytoplasm with hepatitis B surface antigen, confirmed by orcein or immunostaining, marking chronic HBV infection's viral factories under immune tolerance or treatment. The antigen stuffed cell is the **ground glass hepatocyte of chronic hepatitis B**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation.
steps.say: Ground glass cytoplasm means surface antigen factories; stain it and stage the hepatitis B.

vis.caption: Hepatitis patterns across viral, autoimmune, and chronic liver injury.

steps.tx: Chronic hepatitis grades necroinflammatory activity and stages fibrosis from portal expansion through bridging to cirrhosis, because stage predicts outcomes and treatment urgency across aetiologies. That dual report is **grade and stage in chronic hepatitis biopsy**. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Grade tells how angry, stage tells how scarred; stage writes the prognosis in chronic hepatitis.

steps.tx: Interface hepatitis spills inflammation across limiting plate into periportal hepatocytes with plasma cells in autoimmune hepatitis, emperipolesis and rosettes joining its biopsy accent beside high IgG. That border attack is **interface hepatitis of autoimmune liver disease**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: Plasma cell rich interface hepatitis plus high IgG means autoimmune hepatitis until serology votes.

vis.caption: Autoimmune hepatitis biopsy with interface activity and plasma cells.

steps.tx: Autoimmune hepatitis divides by antibodies: ANA and smooth muscle in type one, anti-LKM in childhood type two, answering steroids dramatically yet relapsing on withdrawal in most patients. Steroid responsiveness defines **autoimmune hepatitis treatment expectation**. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: Autoimmune hepatitis melts before steroids and returns when they stop; plan years, not weeks.

steps.tx: Cirrhosis ends chronic injury roads with bridging fibrosis encircling regenerative nodules, distorting vasculature into portal hypertension and hepatocellular failure simultaneously. That architectural endpoint is **cirrhosis, fibrosis plus regenerative nodules**. Remembering it prevents the commonest errors made with this presentation entirely.
steps.say: Cirrhosis is architecture destroyed: fibrous rings, regenerative nodules, failing function, rising pressure.

vis.caption: Cirrhosis and liver failure with portal hypertension consequences.

steps.tx: Compensated cirrhosis may hide behind normal examination while decompensation declares through ascites, variceal bleeding, encephalopathy, or jaundice, each reclassifying prognosis and transplant conversations. That threshold is **decompensated cirrhosis events**. The clinical payoff comes from applying it early, before complications accumulate further.
steps.say: First ascites, bleed, encephalopathy, or jaundice moves cirrhosis into decompensated prognosis territory.
